Answer me!|audio = VoidcoreWave30-3.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 30 ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Void Titan''' is a high health enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. It has high health, higher than every enemy that appeared before it, though it walks at a below average speed. It has one ability where it will slam its hammer at a tower or unit in its range of 10. This will cause a line of shockwave to appear, starting with a shockwave made where the targeted tower or unit is and continuing forward, creating three more shockwaves. Any tower hit by it will get stunned for 3 seconds, while units receive 135 damage. ==Logbook Description== "''During the battle with Two X and Lord Exo, the Void Titans stood with their hammers on the frontlines of battle. They slaughtered countless fighters and were part of the effort when Lord Exo was slaying millions. Lord Exo's influence would not have been as vast without the efforts of the Void, and residents were hunted down and gathered by the Titans to be offered to the Void Caster.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Titan''' has black skin with glowing purple parts on it. It wears a purple chestplate with shoulder-pads that covers its torso, shoulders and waist, a few bands on its arms with glowing purple crystals and a purple helmet. It has glowing purple horns on its head. It carries a large hammer that it uses to stun towers and damage units. ==Strategy== *DPS towers such as the [[Shotgunner]], [[Kingpin]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Turret]] should be used to take down the '''Void Titan'''. **The [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to further support towers to defeat it quicker. *The [[Medic]] can be used to shield towers from its stuns. **Similarly, top path [[Juggernaut]] can instead be used to reduce how long towers are stunned for. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Void Titan''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidTitanCA.png|'''Void Titan''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidTitanIconIG.png|'''Void Titan''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Titan''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Titan''' added, replacing the [[Fallen Titan]]. *'''26 September 2026''' - [[v2.11.0|v2.11.2]] **Now appears in [[Nil Zone II]] as part of the [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]] ==Notes== {{Hardcore|[[Void Pike]]|Wave 28|Void Titan|Wave 30|[[Void Floater]]|Wave 31}} {{Voidcore|[[Void Pike]]|Wave 28|Void Titan|Wave 30|[[Mandragora]]|Wave 31}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
